## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Fortnite OG-inspired game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- User requested OG-style skins, sky, grass, sounds, guns, items, gun sounds, and original locations.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport at most 1280px wide.

## Decisions
- Created an original, browser-playable battle royale called **Riftland**, with original stylized graphics and synthesized sound rather than copying Fortnite assets.
- Implemented a top-down solo island match with 15 players, nine named locations, weapons, loot, bots, building, a shrinking safe zone, UI, and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added playable game interface and responsive styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Implemented canvas gameplay, map, bots, combat, loot, synthesized sound, HUD, pause/end screens, and keyboard/touch controls in `game.js`.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Started a local server at `http://localhost:3002`; browser opened successfully.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/riftland.jpg`.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- Browser check showed only a missing `/favicon.ico` 404; no gameplay errors were observed. Gameplay itself has not yet been verified by deploying into a match.

## Next Move
1. Click **DEPLOY** in the browser, verify the live match and core controls, and capture a gameplay screenshot.
2. Fix any issues uncovered; optionally add a favicon to remove the 404.
3. Report the game as an original-inspired implementation, not a reproduction using Fortnite’s exact graphics, sounds, skins, or assets.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and screens.
- `style.css`: Game presentation and responsive/mobile styling.
- `game.js`: Game logic, rendering, sound, controls, and bot simulation.
- `screenshots/riftland.jpg`: Latest lobby screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` succeeded after installing Chromium.
- The latest screenshot is the initial lobby; deploy and inspect before claiming gameplay is verified.

- Build a complete, playable Fortnite OG-inspired game in the existing project.

- User requested OG-style skins, sky, grass, sounds, guns, items, gun sounds, and original locations.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

- Match design includes 15 players, named island locations, weapons, loot, bots, building, a shrinking safe zone, HUD, and keyboard/touch controls.
